title: fig05 finally resolved: area x band GLMM (subject-controlled) is the headline; three connectivity nulls preserved as supplements; two real GLMM bugs found and fixed along the way
notes: Closes the fig05 saga started earlier 2026-08-04: three real, honestly-computed LFP-LFP connectivity methods (undirected imaginary coherency 0/240, directed Granger causality 0/150, transfer entropy 0/150) all came back null at the group level on this corpus. All three preserved as supplements in context/figures/lfp_lfp_connectivity_supplement/ (folder renamed twice: fig06_band_power_coupling -> fig05_lfp_lfp_coupling -> this).

New fig05 headline: context/figures/fig05_v1_area_hierarchy_glmm/ -- an area x band GLMM (Model F in scripts/fit_omission_band_power_glmm.py), subject controlled as an additive fixed effect, full 23-session/3-subject corpus. 2/45 cells survive Holm-Bonferroni (FEF low-gamma p_holm=0.0076, PFC low-gamma p_holm=0.0088); 11/45 survive BH-FDR (adds V3a/d beta q_BH=0.030, V3a/d low-gamma q_BH=0.030, and others). Both thresholds reported, never conflated.

Before trusting this figure, verified CLAUDE.md's memory-cited number ('V3a/d beta +1.11dB, replicated 17/23-session corpora') against actual analysis output rather than propagating it -- found it matched neither CONTEXT.md's descriptive number (+1.78dB, confounded) nor the existing animal-controlled test (+1.59dB, P=0.076, n=5 one subject). This triggered discovery of two real bugs in fit_omission_band_power_glmm.py: (1) area-pooling dict missing raw label 'V3' itself, silently dropping one subject's qualifying data from every V3a/d-labeled analysis; (2) local bh() function with an inverted rank multiplier, giving the smallest p-value in any family zero correction. Both fixed; full receipt in v3ad_beta_glmm_two_bugs_fixed_20260805.json.

The bh() bug is scoped to this ONE script -- figstats.py (used by every fig02-fig07 figure this entire session) was independently checked and confirmed correct. No other figure's statistics need re-deriving because of this bug.

Added Model F (new) to fit_omission_band_power_glmm.py: db ~ area + subject (additive), full corpus, session-level -- fills a real gap between existing Model C (descriptive, confounded, no subject control) and Model D (subject-controlled but limited to 5 sessions/1 subject by an unavoidable recording-design constraint). Model F is identifiable because the area x subject design is connected, per CLAUDE.md's own pre-existing verification doctrine for this exact corpus.
context/docs/CONTEXT.md's Section on V3a/d elevation updated with the corrected, properly-powered result and full bug disclosure.

context/figures/README.md, build_inventory.py, and build_supplements.py all updated to point at the final folder structure. build_inventory.py --check passes cleanly (no missing README anywhere, including fig06 which now has one documenting its own null).
